title: Integral Zariski decompositions on smooth projective surfaces II
summary: In this paper, we characterize three classes of smooth projective surfaces: relatively minimal elliptic surfaces with $χ\ge 1$, rational surfaces $X$ satisfying that $-K_X$ iis nef and $κ(-K_X)\ge 1$,, and projective K3 surfaces on which every integral pseudoeffective divisor admits an integral Zariski decomposition.
